concerns.text: Tasks T006 and T014 implement 'cosine similarity of sentence embeddings' as a proxy for FR-007's 'attention-weighted token overlap'. While the plan justifies this as a staged deviation, the task deliverable (the code) does not satisfy the literal requirement of FR-007. This is a semantic weakening of the constraint unless the spec is explicitly amended to accept this proxy as the definition of 'recovery-critical' segments. The task currently claims to satisfy FR-007 but delivers a different algorithm.

FR-001 mandates downloading 'Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench'. Tasks T004/T004a implement 'AgentBench' (lmz/agentbench) and log a substitution. This is a silent constitution drift: the task delivers a different dataset than the FR demands. While T039 proposes to fix the spec, the current task list contains a requirement violation where the deliverable (AgentBench data) does not match the requirement (Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench data).

FR-008 defines the inflection point as 'max derivative' or '95% CI non-overlap'. Task T027 introduces a new fallback condition: 'delta threshold (e.g., 10%)' if the fit fails. This adds a logic branch not present in the spec's acceptance criteria, effectively relaxing the definition of the inflection point to include an arbitrary threshold not validated by the spec.

FR-002 requires executing 'Llama-3-8B'. Task T008 implements a fallback to 'Qwen-1.5-1.8B' if the 8B model fails. While the plan allows this for feasibility, the task deliverable (running Qwen) does not satisfy the FR-002 requirement (running Llama-3-8B) unless the spec is amended to accept the fallback as the primary execution target. This is a silent weakening of the model requirement.
